forces.title: AI-driven product comparison boosts demand for financial data.
forces.description: The rise of AI and agentic commerce facilitates easier comparison of financial products and dynamic transaction routing by consumers and businesses. This trend directly increases the need for comprehensive, real-time, and comparable financial data and analytical tools. Ratings and data providers benefit from the heightened demand for structured, accessible information to power these AI-driven decision-making processes, contributing to their growth and market relevance in the evolving financial landscape.
forces.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

forces.title: Regulation mandates explainable AI models, impacting data provision.
forces.description: Regulatory bodies, such as the Bank of England's PRA, are increasingly requiring AI models used in regulated financial decisions (e.g., credit risk, KYC) to be fully explainable, traceable, and continuously validated. This structural shift creates a significant imperative for ratings, research, and data providers to ensure their data sets, methodologies, and analytical tools meet stringent transparency and validation requirements, fostering a demand for more robust and auditable offerings and new service lines.
forces.source_title: The decade to redefine UK banking

forces.title: Banks' AI adoption increases demand for real-time financial insights.
forces.description: Financial institutions are increasingly deploying AI-enabled tools for relationship managers to offer real-time advice and leveraging continuous transaction data for better client engagement and risk management. This internal AI adoption drives a sustained need for high-quality, real-time financial data, predictive analytics, and specialized research from external providers. It allows banks to enhance their service offerings and maintain competitive advantage in a rapidly evolving, data-driven financial market.
forces.source_title: Anchor or drift: What it takes to capture wallet share in 2026

forces.title: Insurance AI transformation creates data and model provision opportunities.
forces.description: The insurance industry's deep transformation through AI, aimed at continuous risk monitoring, accurate pricing, and stronger underwriting, presents a significant upside for data and research providers. These companies can offer the essential sophisticated financial data, advanced analytical models, and specialized research capabilities required to power AI systems within insurance firms, catering to the evolving needs for enhanced operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and robust risk management across all lines of business.
forces.source_title: The strategic new arenas reshaping insurance

viewpoints.title: AI transforms insurance operations, increasing demand for data and risk models.
viewpoints.description: McKinsey views AI as a fundamental force reshaping the operating model of insurance across all lines, impacting the infrastructure layer rather than just specific products. This transformation enables more accurate pricing, continuous risk monitoring, and stronger underwriting decisions. This structural shift necessitates robust financial data, advanced analytical models, and specialized research capabilities. Consequently, there will be sustained and increasing demand for comprehensive offerings from ratings, research, and data providers to effectively support these sophisticated AI-driven processes within the evolving insurance sector, creating a positive outlook for their services.
